## Scope / 対象
- Product and authoritative source commit:
- Changed paths:

## Checks actually executed
- [ ] Offline tests (command, OS, Python/Node version, result)
- [ ] Generated artifact / source hash comparison
- [ ] CI status and run links
- [ ] Real browser / Windows / product E2E (or explicitly UNVERIFIED)

## Safety and release
- Published URL/file path compatibility:
- Sensitive data and dependency review:
- Rollback:
- Release decision: candidate / approved / published / blocked, with supporting evidence

Synthetic test success is not live-product E2E success.
